verified_observations: Moore Armenia is described on its official website as a proud member of the Moore Global Network, one of the world's leading accounting and advisory networks with over a century of history, operating in more than 110 countries.
The official website lists 19 service lines across audit and assurance, tax and legal, accounting and outsourcing, and advisory and transactions, plus 12 industry specialisms.
